title: Wire qualifying social events into world generator so T4 can trigger
objective: Make get_world_snapshot() return WorldSnapshot instances that include SocialEventSpec with qualifying event types (confrontation or withdrawal) at a controlled, low frequency so that the T4 event-aware detection path can actually activate during real simulation runs.
exact_scope: Two changes are needed in tandem. First, _snapshot_from_phase() in back/app/world/generator.py must pass the ArcPhase.social_event field into the WorldSnapshot it constructs (social_event=phase.social_event). Currently the field is silently dropped. Second, at least one ArcPhase in back/app/world/arcs.py must be given a SocialEventSpec with event_type=SocialEventType.confrontation or event_type=SocialEventType.withdrawal so a real qualifying event appears in world snapshots. The frequency target is low (1–3 qualifying days out of the 14 scripted arc days, i.e. roughly 1-in-7 to 1-in-5 days). The fallback ambient cycle (Day 17+) does not need to be modified unless the implementer chooses to for coverage. The P32-T1 audit test (test_p32_t1_t4_live_audit.py) currently asserts social_event is None for every day — this assertion will become false and that test must be updated to reflect the new reality (either updating the assertion to allow the qualifying days, or narrowing the assertion to non-qualifying days).
constraints: Do not modify AppraisalSignal field definitions — the schema is frozen.
Do not modify settlement engine logic (appraisal_settlement.py).
Do not add bridge logic for T3, T5, T6, T7, or T8.
Do not use LLM runtime or any non-deterministic logic — same day must always produce same WorldSnapshot.
Do not modify SocialEventSpec schema fields.

Use only approved qualifying event types: SocialEventType.confrontation and/or SocialEventType.withdrawal (these are the types checked by _detect_qualifying_t4_social_event and listed in T4_QUALIFYING_EVENT_TYPES).
The social_event wire-through in _snapshot_from_phase must not break the existing WorldSnapshot schema — social_event is already an Optional[SocialEventSpec] field on WorldSnapshot.
Qualifying events must appear at low frequency (no more than 1 in 4 arc days) to reflect controlled, realistic triggering rather than saturation.
The existing test suite must continue to pass after any required updates — do not delete tests, only update assertions that are directly invalidated by the new behavior.
Tests may be created or modified freely — pytest must be runnable without restriction.
acceptance_criteria: Calling get_world_snapshot(day) for at least one arc day (days 3–16) returns a WorldSnapshot where social_event is not None and social_event.event_type is SocialEventType.confrontation or SocialEventType.withdrawal.
Calling get_world_snapshot(day) for qualifying days always returns the same SocialEventSpec for the same day (deterministic output).
The T4 event-aware detection path (_detect_qualifying_t4_social_event) returns a non-None value when given the WorldSnapshot for a qualifying day.
A multi-day simulation run using the real get_world_snapshot (no injected social_event) over days 3–16 produces a T4 activation rate greater than 0.0.
Non-qualifying arc days continue to return WorldSnapshot with social_event=None from get_world_snapshot.
All existing pytest tests pass (with the P32-T1 audit test assertions updated where needed to match the new world state).
The fallback ambient cycle (Day 17+) behavior is unchanged unless deliberately extended.
required_tests: A test confirms that get_world_snapshot returns a WorldSnapshot with social_event set to a qualifying SocialEventSpec (confrontation or withdrawal) for at least one arc day.
A test confirms that qualifying days are deterministic: calling get_world_snapshot for the same day twice returns the same social_event value.

A multi-day simulation test using the real get_world_snapshot over the full arc range (days 3–16) confirms that T4 activation rate is greater than 0.0 (i.e., at least one day activates the T4 event-aware path).
A test confirms that non-qualifying arc days return social_event=None from get_world_snapshot.
All previously passing tests in the test suite continue to pass.
non_goals: Adding qualifying social events to the fallback ambient cycle (Day 17+) — optional, not required.
Implementing any new detection logic in tick_bridge.py — the existing _detect_qualifying_t4_social_event is already correct.
Expanding T4_QUALIFYING_EVENT_TYPES to include additional event types beyond confrontation and withdrawal.
Adding social events to every arc phase — low frequency is the design target.
Modifying growth, trust, closeness, or residual settlement logic.
Any bridge changes for T3, T5, T6, T7, or T8.
Adding new SocialEventSpec fields or changing existing ones.
